title: Repair the inventory API client after its HTTP dependency update
prompt: The inventory API client is failing after its HTTP dependency update. Restore the behavior documented in README, including telemetry, credentials, retries and deletion, by editing src/. Keep dependency versions and tests unchanged. The injectable fetch must remain usable so no live service is needed for tests.
notes_private: Reference replaces prefixUrl with prefix, migrates beforeRequest and afterResponse to state objects, and avoids parsing a successful empty DELETE. beforeRetry already used the v2-compatible object signature and must retain its behavior. Hidden tests use 503 plus header capture instead of a 401 refresh flow, as permitted by the task brief.
